contact.address: 5518 Sherbrooke St W, Montreal, Quebec H4A 1W2

charcoal.role: Primary surface — the painted storefront brick and awning ground

slate.role: Elevated surface / cards / storefront frame blue-grey

ember.role: Primary accent — flame orange from the signage

flame.role: Hot accent — the red in 'ET' and the OUVERT neon

gold.role: Signature — the gold of 'MR' and flame highlights

cream.role: Type on dark, the cream of 'SMOKE' and 'SLICE'

display.reference: Signage uses a heavy condensed slab/gothic with a metallic gold-to-cream gradient
display.usage: Headlines, section titles. Uppercase, tight tracking (-0.02em).

accent.usage: Prices, badges, nav — mirrors the 'HAMBURGER • PIZZA • FIRE GRILLED' banner strip.

logo.lockup: Stacked: 'MR' (gold) above 'SMOKE' (cream) + 'ET' (flame red) + 'SLICE' (cream), tagline underneath in small caps
logo.clearSpace: Minimum 0.5× the cap-height of 'MR' on all sides
logo.onLight: Use charcoal lockup with ember accents
logo.onDark: Use cream lockup with gold/ember accents (primary usage)

voice.bilingual: French first, English second — matches the awning. Never machine-translated tone.

photography.direction: Close, hand-held, hot-off-the-grill. Real hands in frame. Charred edges, visible cheese pull, matte metal pizza pans, dark walnut tables.
photography.lighting: Single warm key from the side, deep charcoal falloff, ember-coloured rim light.
